sources.entry: sqladmin - An admin interface for SQLAlchemy models in FastAPI and Starlette.

summary.one_liner: SQLAdmin is an admin interface for SQLAlchemy models that plugs into Starlette and FastAPI applications.
summary.what_it_does: SQLAdmin provides a web admin interface for SQLAlchemy models. You register a model by subclassing ModelView and passing the model, then add that view to an Admin object created with your FastAPI or Starlette app and a SQLAlchemy engine. The README shows column_list configuration and visiting /admin in a browser to reach the interface. It lists support for SQLAlchemy sync and async engines, WTForms-based form building, and SQLModel models. The UI is built with Tabler. Optional extras add session-backed authentication (itsdangerous) and internationalization (babel).
use_cases: add an admin panel to a FastAPI app
browse and edit SQLAlchemy model records in a browser
internal back-office tool for a database
quickly expose CRUD screens for database tables
admin UI for a Starlette application
how_to_run: Create a FastAPI or Starlette app, then: admin = Admin(app, engine)
Define class UserAdmin(ModelView, model=User) with column_list, then admin.add_view(UserAdmin) and visit /admin
notable: Works with both FastAPI and plain Starlette apps
Supports SQLAlchemy sync and async engines
Configuration style modeled on Flask-Admin (per the README)
Optional extras for auth and i18n keep the base install small
Live demo available (credentials given in README)
caveats: Authentication and internationalization require installing optional extras
README does not describe deployment or production hardening
Project details beyond the quickstart are referenced to external documentation that is not included in the README text
